line_items.description: Room Charge - Deluxe Spree-View Atelier Suite (Night 1)
Room Charge - Deluxe Spree-View Atelier Suite (Night 2)
Priority Garment Pressing Service (1x Suit & Cravat)
Minibar: Gold-Leaf Salted Marcona Almonds (45g tin)
Minibar: Artisan Organic Fermented Mate Soda

reasoning: Two-night Berlin stay for investor meetings; the nights of October 14 and 15, 2024 begin on a Monday and a Tuesday, so no night falls on a weekend or public holiday and the weekend flowchart does not apply. The note names investor meetings rather than a declared trade-fair or congress event from the Chapter 9 table, so no event surcharge cap applies and Berlin's ordinary €160 Tier 2 cap governs; the 'Atelier Suite' category earns no higher cap, so each €230 night is reimbursed at €160 with €70 deducted per night. The note states that a garment was soiled by a spill during lunch, so the €28 garment pressing qualifies for the €25 short-stay garment-rescue cap and €3.00 is deducted. Both minibar lines are deducted in full, since minibar snacks and beverages are excluded whatever they cost. The note identifies the rental car, so the €70 two-night self-parking is reimbursed up to €30 per night, i.e. €60, with €10 deducted. City tax is reimbursed in full. VAT is allocated at the folio's single printed 7% rate on the reimbursed net charges, which deducts €12.85 of the €41.20 VAT.
